title: CLAUDE.md
text: Edit README.Rmd, never README.md; re-knit changes commit . NAMESPACE man/ generated roxygen2 (markdown enabled); never hand-edit. Call ggplot2 functions ggplot2:: add @importFrom roxygen block. R/ggpyramid-package.R holds package-level imports. testthat edition 3. New code goes R/<topic>.R tests/testthat/test-<topic>.R. Add every user-visible change NEWS.md. entry “(development version)”, R CMD check reports “news entries found” NOTE; expected disappears first numbered release. .gitattributes forces LF line endings; CI runs Linux, macOS Windows.
